comparisons.headlineClaimText: Total speedup 9.88×: hardware speedup 1.77×, self-improving CI speedup 5.59× on StarSling Runners and — on GitHub-hosted runners. Evidence: coverage-qualified.

disqualificationReasons: Self-improving CI changed which runners jobs use, so its speedup includes a hardware change.
